policy: One shared original dry v5 reference on all playback variants. Fit a causal 48 ms FIR from pre-command samples using a fixed ridge penalty on 4090. Locate the dry speech with signed normalized correlation around the measured OPEN after confirming a decoded triple. Subtract only the predicted reference contribution; keep the pre-roll, duration, sample clock and remainder. Neither true room impulse, source command clock nor text enters estimation. This is retrospective server-side analysis, capture/stability and live latency require hardware.
